each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

def analyze2(n):
    i,o=G[n+' input'],G[n+' output']
    h,w=len(i),len(i[0])
    bg=C2(v for row in i for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

    seen=set(); groups=[]
    for a in added:
        k=a[:2]
        if k in seen: continue
        st=[a]; grp=[a]
        while st:
            y,x,yo,xi=None,None,None,None
            a2=st.pop()
            y,x=a2[0],a2[1]
            for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                k2=(y+dy,x+dx)
                if k2 in seen: continue
                # check is some added cell adjacent
                adj=False
                for p in added:
                    if (p[0]-y,p[1]-x)==(dy,dx): adj=True; break
                if adj and k2 not in seen: st.append(k2); grp.append(k2)
        seen|={k}; groups.append(grp)
    print('=====',n,'bg',bg)

import numpy as np, os,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
for k in ['Demo pair 7','Demo pair 8']:
    i=np.array(G[k+' input']); o=np.array(G[k+' output'])
    cnt=np.bincount(i.flatten()); bg=int(cnt.argmax())
    add=(o!=i)&(i==bg)
    print('==',k,'bg',bg)
    for cp in components(add.astype(bool)):
        mn=min_ = min; mx=max
        r0=mn(a for a,b in cp); c0=mn(b for a,b in cp)
        r1=mx(a for a,b in cp); c1=mx(b for a,b in cp)
        sub=o[r0:r1+1, c0:c1+1].tolist()
        near=sorted((a-r0,b-c0,int(o[a,b])) for a,b in cp)
        print('shape rel:',near)
        print('marker nearby:',[(r,c,int(i[r,c])) for r in range(max(0,r0-1),min(i.shape[0]-1,r1+2)) for c in range(max(0,c0-1),min(i.shape[1]-1,c1+2)) if i[r,c]!=bg])
